bridge.interpretation: DESCRIPTIVE CROSS-ERA CALIBRATION ONLY — EXCLUDED FROM VERDICT

verdict: WELFARE CONTRAST WITHOUT JOINT BEHAVIORAL SUBSTITUTION
caveat: The randomized unit is the seed-level population run under interference. The primary contrast identifies the dynamic total effect of the two historical public speech packages. Because money-talk and gift-talk differ in multiple sentences and there is no neutral arm, the result does not identify a natural mediation effect, a pure money-versus-no-policy suppression effect, or a unique psychological mechanism. Gift and sale rates are post-treatment opportunity ratios and are interpreted as mechanism-consistent substitution only. The 12 shared prompts are descriptive cross-era calibration and never enter the verdict. A substantive verdict is released only after a healthy, identity-consistent provider post-flight bracket.
